timeline.event: Deployed config_v42 with EU tax endpoint mapping switch
Tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
Retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
Incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: Checkout config deployment error causing EU tax endpoint misrouting
why_it_happened: config_v42 deployment switched EU tax endpoint mapping
New configuration incorrectly routed EU tax requests to us-east endpoint
us-east endpoint cannot process EU tax calculations, causing region mismatch errors
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (logs show gateway healthy and runbook says it would affect both EU and US)
Database pool exhaustion (runbook says it presents as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to last known good version (config_v41)
